title: Cross-Domain Trajectory Association Based on Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Enhanced Attention Hypergraph

layout.note: Four black-framed boxes in three columns: the SocialNetwork frame at the left, the local module (a) stacked above the global module (b) in the middle, and the fusion module (c) at the right; elbow connectors fan out of the first frame and merge into the last.

lesson: Open the figure with a small worked example frame (users, icon trajectories, a line-style legend), then branch into two lettered module frames and merge them into a fusion frame, keeping the branch colours (red local, blue global) on grids and strips all the way to the fusion.
